scope: Independent review of original records and frames; harness/corpus/infrastructure findings, not new app defect claims. All original task and physical acceptance remain open.

observations.limits: These downstream route blockers are not app feature failures. No UX ranking may use them.

observations.limits: A missing-command error here does not establish absence of vault search. New unit test reproduces and guards the lookup correction.

observations.observation: All four second-run guests abort with Keyboard did not dismiss. The landscape fatal frame is already the home screen; repeated Back has left the editor. No module probe was executed in that run.
observations.limits: The keyboard observer used mInputShown OR mIsInputViewShown. The exact full dumps were not preserved in that run, so which stale flag fired cannot be independently proved from the truncated command prefix. This is not a production keyboard defect finding.
observations.comparison_harness_change: Use the manager state only, never the IME view flag; retain full dumps and require an exact app-owned input plus typed-value readback. Unit test guards a hidden IME view producing no Back.
